properties.name: description
properties.label: Description
properties.value: Smart Farmer Search API - Progressive criteria-based farmer lookup with fuzzy matching

options.label: Enable Soundex and Levenshtein matching for names

title: Generic Registry (reuse for any registry, not just farmers)

properties.name: registryTable
properties.label: Registry table
properties.description: Set to search any Joget form table (e.g. app_fd_dsp_taxpayer) instead of the farmer view. Leave blank to keep farmer mode.

properties.name: identifierColumn
properties.label: Identifier column (→ stored value)
properties.description: The registry identifier, e.g. c_tin. Rendered in the National ID slot; this is what gets stored on selection.

properties.name: secondaryColumn
properties.label: Secondary display column
properties.description: Optional, e.g. a second name part.

properties.name: searchColumns
properties.label: Search columns (comma-separated)
properties.description: Columns the free-text term matches, e.g. c_tin,c_name. Defaults to identifier + primary.
